title: Alerts
emptyDescription: Alerts can be created from <dashboardLink>dashboard charts</dashboardLink>, <searchLink>saved searches</searchLink>, and the <chartLink>chart explorer</chartLink>.
docsHint: Alerts can be <link>created</link> from dashboard charts, saved searches, and the chart explorer.
loadFailedDescription: Something went wrong fetching your alerts.
noMatchingAlertsDescription: Try adjusting your search or filters.
scheduleControlsHint: Optional schedule controls for aligning alert windows.
consecutiveWindowsTooltip: Number of consecutive evaluation windows that must breach the threshold before an alert fires. Useful for reducing noise from transient spikes.
startOffsetTooltip: Delays the start of each evaluation window by this many minutes. Useful when data is ingested with a lag.
startOffsetIgnored: Start offset is ignored while an anchor start time is set.
anchorStartTimeTooltip: Pins alert windows to a fixed starting point instead of the default rolling schedule. Windows repeat at the configured interval from this time.
localTimeHint: Displayed in local time, stored as UTC
name: Name
derivedNamePlaceholder: Defaults to the saved search or dashboard tile name
notePlaceholder: Why does this alert exist? Threshold history, links to runbooks, etc. Supports markdown.
silenceFailed: Failed to silence alert, please try again later.
silenceInvalidDuration: Invalid request. Please ensure the silence duration is valid.
ackMenuFailed: Failed to load alert acknowledgment menu
deleteFailed: Something went wrong. Please contact {{brand}} team.
groupedByNoDataWarning: Warning: Alerts with this threshold type and a "grouped by" value will not alert for periods with no data for a group.
floatEqualityNote: Note: Floating-point query results are not rounded during equality comparison.
saveFailed: Something went wrong. Please contact {{brand}} team.
groupsTruncated: Showing the top {{limit}} of {{total}} groups (firing first) — additional groups aren't fetched.
unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and close the editor?
invalidAlertMessage: This alert must keep an alert configured to be saved.
alertQueryUnavailableDescription: This alert's chart configuration could not be loaded.
savedSearchUnavailable: Unable to load the saved search behind this alert.
singleValueRawSqlMessage: This alert runs a raw SQL query that returns one value per window, so it has no chart over time.
tileTypeNotPreviewable: This tile type can't be previewed here.
alertChartNotPreviewable: This alert's chart can't be previewed here.
alertTypeNotPreviewable: This alert type can't be previewed here.
noEvaluations: No evaluations in the selected time range.
notificationDurationTooltip: Wall time delivering this evaluation's notifications, including retries. Targets are dispatched concurrently, so the slowest one in each dispatch round sets this figure.
backfilledTooltip_one: {{count}} earlier tick was missed (job delay or failed evaluations); the bucket was backfilled in this evaluation.
backfilledTooltip_other: {{count}} earlier ticks were missed (job delay or failed evaluations); the buckets were backfilled in this evaluation.
